function.description: For SSID/WLAN runtime queries, if hostname/IP/serial is provided instead of networkDeviceId, resolve the controller first with get_device_details and pass the returned canonical networkDeviceId. For controller serial-number WLAN/SSID detail queries, first call get_device_details and then call this api; do not use api_getPnP*. For out-of-band SSID/WLAN queries only: treat out-of-band as managed=false and call this API with managed=false; For provisioned SSID/WLAN queries only: treat provisioned as managed=true and call this API with managed=true;
function.name: api_getSSIDDetailsForSpecificWirelessController

adminStatus.description: Utilize this query parameter to obtain the administrative status. A 'true' value signifies that the admin status of the SSID is enabled, while a 'false' value indicates that the admin status of the SSID is disabled.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

managed.description: If value is 'true' means SSIDs are configured through design.If the value is 'false' means out of band configuration from the Wireless Controller.

networkDeviceId.description: Obtain the network device ID value by using the API call GET: /dna/intent/api/v1/network-device/ip-address/${ipAddress}.

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

ssidName.description: Employ this query parameter to obtain the details of the SSID corresponding to the provided SSID name.

adminStatus.description: Utilize this query parameter to obtain the administrative status. A 'true' value signifies that the admin status of the SSID is enabled, while a 'false' value indicates that the admin status of the SSID is disabled.

l2Security.description: This represents the identifier for the Layer 2 authentication type. The authentication types supported include wpa2_enterprise, wpa2_personal, open, wpa3_enterprise, wpa3_personal, wpa2_wpa3_personal, wpa2_wpa3_enterprise, and open-secured.

l3Security.description: This represents the identifier for the Layer 3 authentication type. The authentication types supported are 'open' and 'webauth'.

managed.description: If the value is 'true,' the SSID is configured through design; if 'false,' it indicates out-of-band configuration on the Wireless LAN Controller.

radioPolicy.description: This represents the identifier for the radio policy. The policies supported include 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz.
